STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_07647_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_07647_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_07647(CLK, RESET, PB, DPB, SCEN, MCEN, CCEN);

input CLK, RESET;
input PB;

output DPB;
output SCEN, MCEN, CCEN;

parameter N_dc = 5;

reg [5:0] state;
reg [N_dc-1:0] debounce_count;
reg [3:0] MCEN_count;

assign {DPB, SCEN, MCEN, CCEN} = state[5:2];

localparam
 INI = 6'b000000,
 WQ = 6'b000001,
 SCEN_st = 6'b111100,
 WH = 6'b100000,
 MCEN_st = 6'b101100,
 CCEN_st = 6'b100100,
 MCEN_cont = 6'b101101,
 CCR = 6'b100001,
 WFCR = 6'b100010;

always @ (posedge CLK or posedge RESET)
begin
    if (RESET)
    begin
        state <= INI;
        debounce_count <= 0;
        MCEN_count <= 0;
    end
    else
    begin
        case (state)
            INI: begin
                debounce_count <= 0;
                MCEN_count <= 0;  
                if (PB)
                    state <= WQ;
            end
            WQ: begin
                debounce_count <= debounce_count + 1;
                if (!PB)
                    state <= INI;
                else if (debounce_count[N_dc-2])
                    state <= SCEN_st;
            end
            SCEN_st: begin
                debounce_count <= 0;
                MCEN_count <= MCEN_count + 1;
                state <= WH;
            end
            WH: begin
                debounce_count <= debounce_count + 1;
                if (!PB)
                    state <= CCR;
                else if (debounce_count[N_dc-1])
                    state <= MCEN_st;
            end
            MCEN_st: begin
                debounce_count <= 0;
                MCEN_count <= MCEN_count + 1;
                state <= CCEN_st;
            end
            CCEN_st: begin
                debounce_count <= debounce_count + 1;
                if (!PB)
                    state <= CCR;
                else if (debounce_count[N_dc-2])
                begin
                    if (MCEN_count == 4'b1000)
                        state <= MCEN_cont;
                    else
                        state <= MCEN_st;
                end
            end
            MCEN_cont: begin
                if (!PB)
                    state <= CCR;
            end
            CCR: begin
                debounce_count <= 0;
                MCEN_count <= 0;
                state <= WFCR;
            end
            WFCR: begin
                debounce_count <= debounce_count + 1;
                if (PB)
                    state <= WH;
                else if (debounce_count[N_dc-2])
                    state <= INI;
            end
        endcase
    end
end

endmodule
